Bheem cannot read its saved data on this phone (its key is gone, for example after moving to a new phone). Erasing starts fresh. Your notes, tasks and history here will be lost.
Bheem is an assistant that lives on your phone. Type what you need, or hold Talk and say it: reminders, tasks, notes, calendar events and drafted messages.
Bheem sends nothing off your phone. There is no account and no cloud, and your words are understood on the phone itself.
Bheem never acts on its own. Every action shows a card first and waits for your tap.

Last check: everything Bheem has saved here will be gone, and Bheem will start fresh.
Also remove the language model (about 2.6 GB; you will need to get it again)

Bheem is open source under the Apache License 2.0 (the LICENSE file in the project).

It uses these, each under its own licence:

- Gemma 4 E2B language model, Apache License 2.0 (as recorded in Bheem's model list).
- LiteRT-LM, the library that runs the model on the phone, Apache License 2.0.
- SQLCipher for Android, which encrypts Bheem's saved data, BSD-style licence from Zetetic.
- AndroidX and Jetpack Compose, Apache License 2.0.
- Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines, Apache License 2.0.

Full texts are in the project repository.
